connector.name: Recapfy
connector.registryDescription: Ask about a YouTube video or fetch its transcript. Paid per call in USDC on Solana via x402.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package recapfy-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pedrot95dev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: SVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Base58-encoded Solana secret key. Pays per call (dynamic USDC price). Keep it funded; use a dedicated low-balance wallet.

env.name: RECAPFY_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (defaults to https://api.recapfy.ai). For local dev only.

env.name: RECAPFY_ALLOW_INSECURE_TLS
env.description: Set to 1 to accept self-signed TLS (localhost dev over https only).
